headline: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
summary: OpenAI dissolved its preparedness team last month, according to the Financial Times. The team's role was to assess serious risks posed by AI models and develop mitigation strategies. Responsibilities for evaluating and reducing risks have reportedly been shifted internally.

headline: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal crafted a hip hop breakup masterpiece
summary: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal's album 'DOOMED!' explores the challenging theme of breakups. The record is praised for mining artistic gold from a well-trodden subject. Eagle's signature personal subject matter shines through on this new release.

headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon has updated its terms and conditions, mandating dispute resolution through arbitration. The new terms include a class-action waiver, limiting customers' ability to join lawsuits. Amazon frames this as a 'fast and efficient' way to resolve issues, but critics see it as an attempt to avoid large legal challenges.

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's new 'Computer History' feature on its macOS desktop app tracks user actions. This activity data helps train the AI, enabling it to learn user workflows and suggest automations. The feature builds a timeline for ChatGPT and Codex to reference when responding to requests.

headline: Heroes Star Hayden Panettiere Dies at 36
summary: Actress Hayden Panettiere, known for her role in 'Heroes,' has reportedly died at 36. Her entertainment career spanned three decades as a former child actor. No further details regarding her passing were provided in the brief report.

headline: Lanterns Showrunner Says That Episode 1 Surprise Ending Was ‘Big and Scary’ to Commit To
summary: Chris Mundy, showrunner for the new DC series 'Lanterns,' discussed the impactful Episode 1 ending. He described the surprise conclusion as 'big and scary' to commit to during production. The series is part of James Gunn's vision for the DC universe.

headline: 'Look Forward to Meetin' Ya, Sugah!' — Rogue Voice Actress Lenore Zann Reacts to MCU X-Men Casting With Special Video Message for Inde Navarrette
summary: Lenore Zann, the iconic voice of Rogue in Marvel animated projects, congratulated Inde Navarrette. Navarrette has been cast as the live-action Rogue in the upcoming MCU X-Men reboot. Zann shared a special video message to welcome her successor.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Sparks Theories About 2 Doctor Dooms as Fans Hope for a Surprise Cameo from Cillian Murphy
summary: The new 'Avengers: Doomsday' trailer has ignited fan speculation. Viewers are theorizing about the potential presence of two Doctor Dooms in the film. Many fans are also holding out hope for a surprise cameo from actor Cillian Murphy.

headline: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
summary: Jared Kushner, US President Trump's son-in-law and envoy, has arrived in Israel. His visit follows unusual talks with Hamas representatives regarding a Gaza peace plan. Kushner is scheduled to meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu today.

headline: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service, BBC told
summary: The Child Maintenance Service (CMS) is reportedly pushing parents to their breaking point. Mothers describe arduous battles to ensure ex-partners fulfill payment obligations. Conversely, fathers claim they have been erroneously charged thousands by the service.

headline: UK to turn cooler with rain after exceptional heat and dry spell
summary: The UK is set to experience a shift to cooler, wetter weather. This change comes after an exceptional summer marked by prolonged heatwaves and a dry spell. Meteorologist Simon King explains the upcoming atmospheric transition.

headline: Post-mortems to take place after five boys killed in crash on wrong side of motorway
summary: Five boys tragically died in a motorway crash after their car drove on the wrong side. Post-mortems are scheduled to determine the exact cause of death for the victims. Three women and a child from a second vehicle involved are hospitalized with serious injuries.
